name: Teen Advisory Board (TAB), Edison Public Library
what_you_do: Teens meet each month on the teen board. They help shape library services. They also find volunteer opportunities. The library calls TAB the starting point for teen volunteering.
deadline_text: Monthly. The listing shows the next sessions as Monday, Nov 9, 2026, North Edison Branch, and Wednesday, Nov 18, 2026, Main Library Children's Room. Both are 7:00 to 8:30 p.m.
how_to_apply: Register on the library event listing (registration required). Meetings alternate between the Main Library and the North Edison Branch; members may attend at either. Main Library: 340 Plainfield Avenue, Edison, 732-287-2298.
notes: The October 14 session is over. The page prints no year, but 2026 fits the weekdays. The library's own Young Adults page had no volunteer details. Confirm the meeting location when you register.
